summary: Iteration 8 — Full backend + frontend QA of the new To-Do sharing controls and role-aware Blog. All 19 pytest backend cases pass; all 18 frontend checks (owner + marketing view + sales + crew) pass. No blocking bugs. Test task_meta docs cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_records (line ~1877): tasks/blog list endpoint calls Airtable then filters in Python. Fine at current row counts, but for tasks the mongo task_meta lookup is 'find all' (up to 2000 docs) every request — cheap now, but if task_meta grows, either (a) index-look-up per record id or (b) constrain the query to record ids returned from Airtable would be more efficient.

server.py update_record (line ~1909): crew/sales/marketing PATCH tasks with a NON-status field returns 403 'You can only move a task between columns'. Correct, but the 'shared with your team' check happens AFTER the field-check, meaning an unshared record with a non-status field returns the field-check error first. Order is fine, just worth documenting that the two 403 error messages are order-dependent (main agent's curl matrix already verified this).

Blog.jsx owner branch: when Airtable is unavailable (error state) the kanban does NOT render — the EmptyState card takes over. That's the shared list-page pattern (same as tasks/leads/etc), so consistent behaviour. In preview env this means the 4 status columns are only visually verifiable AFTER Airtable is configured — automated tests here can only assert new-post-btn is present. Not a bug, just something for the next tester to note.

Tasks.jsx: 'Everyone' chip visually distinct (orange fill vs slate) — good affordance. Toggling it OFF when already ON sets audience back to []. Confirmed by save-button label flip Save→Send→Save. Solid UX.

Layout.jsx NAV: 'To-Do' and 'Blog' now include 'employee' role (legacy crew view via legacy password). Backend ROLE_TABLES only lists tasks/blog for [owner, sales, employee, marketing, crew] — so 'employee' role also has table access to tasks/blog now, matching frontend nav. Consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (18/18 checks passed across owner, marketing view, sales, crew)

test_credentials: Owner HaulYeahOwner / HaulYeah2026! (worked). Sales legacy blank username + SellMoves2026! (worked). Crew javante@haulyeahmoves.com / JavCrew2026! (worked). Marketing view via owner role-switch-select → 'Marketing view' (worked).
seed_data_creation: During pytest 3 fake Airtable record ids were briefly upserted into task_meta (recTEST_*): (1) filter-and-sort test, (2) reset-to-empty test, (3) crew-shared PATCH test. All 3 rows deleted at end of their tests. Final scan: 0 recTEST_* rows remain. Real task_meta row count unchanged (1 pre-existing). No other collections mutated. No Square invoices created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite /app/backend/tests/test_todo_blog_sharing.py runs in ~4s with '-o addopts=' to skip the pytest.ini xdist config. It uses python-dotenv to load /app/frontend/.env + /app/backend/.env so MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL work regardless of shell env. Coverage: (a) POST /api/tasks/{id}/audience owner-only + input sanitisation, (b) non-owner tasks/blog GET returns 503 not 403 (Airtable missing), (c) crew task create+patch guards, (d) marketing/sales blog patch + crew blog create 403s. Airtable is still empty in preview — all Airtable-fronted endpoints legitimately 503 on any table CRUD after gate-passing. Blog owner kanban only renders when posts load — in preview (503) an EmptyState appears instead; not a bug. Frontend password login MUST use page.keyboard.type() with delay>=15ms (documented since iteration 7); page.fill() leaves the submit button disabled. role-switch-select is a shadcn button — open + click get_by_role('option', name='...view'). Everyone chip toggles all 3 groups on/off and flips dialog title Save task↔Mass message and save-button label Save task↔Send to everyone.
